title: Tech Note: Setting Up a PIN Authentication System
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Generate password hash / Verify password hash
ds.user ORDA table for PIN storage

historical_commentary.text: This is a UI/application-level custom authentication pattern layered on top of 4D's built-in Current user and password-hash commands, not a core platform feature; it remains fully valid and current since it relies on stable, still-supported 4D commands (Generate/Verify password hash, Current user), though a project today might implement PIN storage as a proper 4D class rather than loose form/project methods.
related_updates: Generate password hash / Verify password hash and Current user remain current, supported 4D commands with no replacement
Modern equivalents of this pattern (e.g., a companion 2FA/TOTP Tech Note published later) show 4D's authentication tooling story has expanded, but this PIN approach itself is not deprecated
